在我看来，当人工智能深度参与艺术创作，并从根本上改变艺术创作范式时，人类应辩证看: In my view, when artificial intelligence deeply participates in artistic creation and fundamentally transforms the paradigm of artistic creation, humanity should view the limitations of both people and machines dialectically, examine more rationally and seriously the value of human beings and the essence of artistic creation, and thereby find ways to bridge the gap, allowing "human-machine co-creation" to develop better.
艺术创作是人的创造力的体现、情感的抒发、精神的迹化，在这一点上人工智能目前还远不: Artistic creation is a manifestation of human creativity, an expression of emotion, and a trace of the human spirit. In this regard, artificial intelligence currently falls far short of matching humanity, and the generalization capabilities of machines are also insufficient, making it difficult to handle highly uncertain scenarios or those requiring intuition and moral considerations.
人工智能高能，但并非万能: Artificial intelligence is powerful, but not omnipotent.
未来，人类与人工智能深度协同是必然发展趋势，我们既需要不断突破技术屏障赋予机器更: In the future, deep collaboration between humanity and artificial intelligence is an inevitable developmental trend. We need both to continuously break through technological barriers to endow machines with higher intelligence, and to view artificial intelligence as an assistant and a candid friend, leveraging the strengths of "machines" to compensate for our own shortcomings, thereby opening up more new application scenarios and pioneering new aesthetic paradigms.
